name: skilltap
description: Official skills for using skilltap — install, discover, and author agent skills, plugins, and taps.

skills.name: skilltap
skills.description: Install, update, remove, list, configure, and inspect agent skills and plugins via the skilltap CLI. Covers state files, filesystem layout, agent-mode rules, and troubleshooting.

skills.name: skilltap-find
skills.description: Discover and search for agent skills and plugins via skilltap taps and the skills.sh registry. Covers source formats, tap management, and trust tiers.

skills.name: skilltap-author
skills.description: Create, scaffold, validate, and publish agent skills, plugins, and taps. Covers SKILL.md frontmatter, plugin manifests (Claude Code + Codex), tap.json indexes, provenance, and publishing workflows.
